title: AI and Technology Strategy
description: Focusing on how AI will redefine businesses in the digital age, we’ll study the fundamental topics of innovation driven by AI+X revolution, disruptive technologies, and digital transformation; learn the TOE theory and S curves to discriminate between trends and fads; how to make decisions about investment in technologies and new ventures, and look into the game changers in many industries (e.g., hi-tech, finance, healthcare), preparing students to become leaders in the tech-intensive world. Credit will not be allowed for MGT 127R and MGT 127. Prerequisites: upper-division standing.
